verdict.rationale: TruffleHog has no llms.txt (the probe returned HTTP 404). However, its docs are served as raw Markdown with frontmatter: docs.md returned HTTP 200, and pages such as pre-commit-hooks.md and custom-detectors.md exist. That gives an agent machine-readable docs to ingest, though nothing labels them as agent-oriented. missing for 10: an llms.txt index, explicitly documented agent-oriented docs or guidance, an OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Pre-commit hooks are a useful way to prevent secrets in code from being pushed from a git repository.
